argv: $r='E:\pc-github-relay'; Write-Output 'STATUS'; git -C $r status --porcelain=v2 -b; Write-Output 'REBASE'; if(Test-Path "$r\.git\rebase-merge"){Get-ChildItem "$r\.git\rebase-merge" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name}else{Write-Output 'none'}; Write-Output 'HEADS'; git -C $r rev-parse HEAD; git -C $r rev-parse origin/agent/pc-github-relay; Write-Output 'AHEAD_BEHIND'; git -C $r rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/agent/pc-github-relay; Write-Output 'LOG'; git -C $r log --oneline --decorate -8
